correctness.rationale: The Chinese remainder splitting isolates the X^q+1 nilpotent factor, and the coprime complement is invertible. The integer identity for binomial valuations gives Y^q=pY^{q/p}W with W a unit and pY^q=0. Explicit independent p²-layer generators of Y^tA for t≤q give p^{min(2t,t+d)} kernel order; for t≥q the image equals pY^{d+t-q}A and gives the final p^{min(2t,t+d,2q)} exponent, with exact endpoints. The standalone standard-library verifier passed four local modular row/column checks, five full cyclic-matrix checks, and an exhaustive 531441-state n=6,p=3 census. Tests are finite and the universal proof is algebraic.

value.rationale: The literature studies the maximal time before a cyclic-sum orbit enters its periodic core. The new law determines the full natural entrance-time invariant for every nonsemisimple odd-prime-square length family, exposes a sharp p²-to-p growth phase at p^{s-1}, determines exact final-depth fraction 1-1/p, and is applicable uniformly to every eligible p,n rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
